title: 第21章 这还是修仙界吗第22章 组队
slug: 道爷斗法累了西幻炸个鱼怎么了
lines: “而这筑基修士，虽能进入，但和可抱团行动的炼气修士不同，一旦踏入秘境之中，便会被传送到各处，难以和队友取得联系，要独自面对秘境之中的种种挑战，存活的几率反而要不如那些集体行动的炼气修士们。”
“百年前，那大齐国的皇子是一位千年难遇的修行天才，有着罕见的冰属性变异天灵根，年仅二十便达到了筑基圆满，虽不是完美筑基，但同阶之内也无人能敌，只差临门一脚便可进入金丹。”
“原本这位修行天才已经被顶级宗门的元婴老祖预定为关门弟子，未曾想进入这紫阳秘境之后便断了音讯，再也没出来过，大齐国的皇帝发了疯的想进去寻找，却因为金丹修为会使得秘境崩塌，而被诸多金丹强者拦住，最终眼见秘境关闭。”
落单修士叹了一口气
“不瞒道友，我是大齐国人，这自从失去了天骄继承人之后，大齐皇帝道心破碎，实力大不如前，北边的大燕国乘机南下争雄，侵吞了大齐半数以上的土地，从此以后大齐一蹶不振，失去了和大燕争雄的资格，沦为了二流国家。
我等大齐修士为寻出路，也只得四处奔波。”
见自己说完故国旧事，陈昭一脸沉重，落单修士倒是有些感动了，拍了拍陈昭的肩膀。
“道友有这份同情之心是好的，也不必过于悲怆，我相信大齐国未来一定会诞生新的金丹修士，重新走上争霸的舞台，届时若道友落魄了，大可来投奔我大齐，即便那时不是我，我相信大齐的修士也是欢迎道友这般正义心肠的。”
唉不是，我是想说你们这又是燕国又是齐国的，接下来不会是什么三家分晋，秦楚相争吧，给我干哪来了，这还是修仙界吗？
看那正陷入感动之中的落单修士，陈昭把到了嘴边的话又憋了回去。
就像这方世界东部地区邻近无边汪洋，南部地区瘴气十足遍布山脉与森林，西部地区千里隔壁万里荒漠与雪山，北部地区是一望无际的草原和雪境，怎么看怎么都像是……
唉，别问，十个修仙世界九个都是这样，不要去细究。
抛开那些似曾相识的设定，这紫阳秘境对于陈昭来说，倒是个不错的选择。
反正现在境界也到达了瓶颈，不如去这秘境之中走上一遭。
跟着落单修士一起前进，没过几日，便来到了这秘境入口。
倒是说这不愧金丹大修的洞府啊！
仅仅从远处望去，便是雄伟壮丽，巨大的紫色道府镶嵌在一座山体之中，周遭散布着浓郁的白雾，若是从山脚下往上看去，说是仙人洞府也多有人相信吧！
紫色的屋檐层峦叠起，略微一数便有百层，檐口的瓦上俱雕满了虎头，漆成紫红色的巨大立柱支撑着道府的结构，无数的斗拱相互交叠，打满了泡钉的巨大正门矗立在最前方，已经开启了一个小口，浓重的颜色发白的灵气不断从中外泄而出。
无数修士正挤在秘境前方的空地上，陈昭二人也匆匆前往聚集之地。
即便是聚集之地，显得十分拥挤，但细细看来，修士们也明显抱团在一起，形成一个一个的小团体。
“道友且看，那是大燕国的三皇女，李裳裳”
见队伍最前方人群拥簇的一位女子，落单修士拽了拽陈昭的衣角
“李裳裳今年才30岁，便已经抵达了筑基中期，是千年难遇的修行天才，此行前来秘境不知为何，还请道友要当心此人”
怎么又是千年难遇？倒是显得廉价的起来。
陈昭在心中吐槽道。
见陈昭不太相信的样子，落单修士一手搭上陈昭的肩膀，用神识传音道。
content_en:
"Although this foundation-building monk can enter, he is different from the Qi-Refining monks who can move in groups. Once they step into the secret realm, they will be teleported everywhere, making it difficult to contact their teammates. They have to face various challenges in the secret realm alone, and their chances of survival are not as good as those of the Qi-Refining monks who act in groups."
"A hundred years ago, the prince of the Great Qi Kingdom was a spiritual genius rarely seen in a thousand years. He had a rare ice-type mutated spiritual root. He reached the perfection of foundation building when he was only twenty years old. Although it is not a perfect foundation building, he is unbeatable at the same level. He is only one step away from entering the golden elixir."
"Originally, this cultivation genius has been booked as a closed disciple by the Yuanying Ancestor of the top sect. After he never wanted to enter the Ziyang secret realm, he lost contact and never came out again. The emperor of Da Qi went crazy and wanted to go in and search, but because the cultivation of the golden elixir would cause the secret realm to collapse, he was stopped by many golden elixir experts, and finally saw the secret realm closed."
The lonely monk sighed
"To be honest, fellow Taoist, I am from Da Qi. Since losing the Tianjiao heir, Da Qi's emperor's heart has been broken and his strength is not as good as before. The country of Yan in the north took the opportunity to go south to fight for supremacy and annexed more than half of Da Qi's land. Since then, Da Qi has been in decline. It has lost the qualification to compete with Da Yan and has become a second-rate country.
Daqi monks and I had no choice but to run around in search of a way out. "
Seeing that Chen Zhao had a heavy look on his face after he finished talking about old things about his homeland, the lonely monk was a little moved and patted Chen Zhao on the shoulder.
"It's good for Taoist friends to have such sympathy, and there is no need to be too sad. I believe that Daqi will definitely give birth to new Jindan monks in the future, and they will once again enter the stage of competition for hegemony. If Taoist friends are in despair, they can come to Daqi. Even if it is not me at that time, I believe that the monks of Daqi will welcome Taoist friends with such a righteous heart."
Alas, no, what I want to say is that you belong to the State of Yan and the State of Qi. The next three families will not be divided into Jin and Qin and Chu. What are you doing? Is this still the world of immortality?
Seeing the lonely monk who was deeply moved, Chen Zhao held back the words that came to his lips.
Just like the eastern part of this world is adjacent to the boundless ocean, the southern part is full of miasma and is full of mountains and forests, the western part is thousands of miles away from desert and snow-capped mountains, and the northern part is endless grassland and snow. No matter how you look at it, it looks like...
Alas, don't ask, nine out of ten worlds of cultivating immortals are like this, don't go into detail.
Putting aside those familiar settings, this Ziyang Secret Realm is a good choice for Chen Zhao.
Anyway, the realm has reached its bottleneck now, so why not take a walk in this secret realm.
Following the lonely monk, we arrived at the entrance of this secret realm within a few days.
On the contrary, this is a cave worthy of Jindan Daxiu!
Just looking from a distance, it is majestic. The huge purple Taoist mansion is embedded in a mountain, with thick white mist scattered around it. If you look up from the foot of the mountain, many people will believe that it is an immortal cave!
The purple eaves are stacked up in layers, and there are hundreds of them at a glance. The tiles on the eaves are all carved with tiger heads. Huge pillars painted purple support the structure of the Taoist mansion. Countless brackets overlap with each other. The huge front door filled with bubble nails stands at the front. A small opening has been opened, and thick white spiritual energy is constantly leaking out from it.
Countless monks were crowding in the open space in front of the secret realm, and Chen Zhao and the others hurried to the gathering place.
Even though the gathering place seemed very crowded, upon closer inspection, it was obvious that the monks were huddled together, forming small groups.
"Look, fellow Taoist, that is the third princess of the Yan Kingdom, Li Changshang."
Seeing a woman crowded with people at the front of the team, the lone monk tugged on the corner of Chen Zhao's clothes.
"Li Changshang is only 30 years old this year, and he has already reached the middle stage of foundation building. He is a cultivation genius that is rare to see in a thousand years. I don't know why I came to the secret realm on this trip. Please be careful of this person."
Why is it a rare occurrence in a thousand years? It does seem cheap.
Chen Zhao complained in his heart.
Seeing that Chen Zhao didn't believe it, the lonely monk put a hand on Chen Zhao's shoulder and used his spiritual consciousness to transmit the message.
